summary: Self-hosted radio with an AI DJ and one shared stream Discussion | Link
content: SUB/WAVE turns your music library into a real radio station: one shared stream, an AI DJ that picks tracks, reads idents and takes requests in plain language. Self-hosted, works with local LLMs, MIT licensed. Web, iOS, Android and desktop players.
chineseSummary: 带有 AI DJ 和一个共享流的自托管电台关联
chineseContent: SUB/WAVE 将您的音乐库变成一个真正的广播电台：一个共享流，一个 AI DJ，可以用简单的语言挑选曲目、读取身份并接受请求。自托管，与当地法学硕士合作，获得麻省理工学院许可。 Web、iOS、Android 和桌面播放器。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
